text.stylize(0, 6, "bold red") # "Hello\t"
print(f"Before expand_tabs: {repr(text.plain)}")
for span in text.spans:
    print(f"Span: {span.start}-{span.end} style={span.style}")

text.expand_tabs()

print(f"After expand_tabs: {repr(text.plain)}")
for span in text.spans:
    print(f"Span: {span.start}-{span.end} style={span.style}")
EOF
python3 /tmp/repro.py
